Same format as lexicon.json: rows are arrays in the order of "fields" (trailing nulls dropped): lemma; id (only for homographs, else null; gloss_en.json refers to entries by id||lemma); forms as printed; pos (n, v, adj, adv, prep, conj, pron, det, art, num, interj, name, abbr, foreign:fr|it|la|de); gender unused (null); ko = Korean gloss; en = short learner definition in simple English (not a translation); ipa = espeak-ng en-us, approximate (none for foreign words and abbreviations); level from FrequencyWords en_50k rank, the lower of lemma and printed forms: A1<=500, A2<=1500, B1<=3500, B2<=7000, C1<=15000, else C2 (names, foreign words, abbreviations have none); first = letter id of first occurrence; letters = space-separated letter ids; example = [tatoeba id, English sentence, null, ko translation|null, author] — English examples come from Tatoeba's CC0 export, so author is "CC0" (no attribution required; still link https://tatoeba.org/sentences/show/<id>); function = 1 for function words. Clitics are their own entries ('s 'm 're 've 'll 'd); n't contractions are whole entries. See data/lexicon/README.md.
